import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.math.BigDecimal;

/**
 * COMPREHENSIVE DIGITAL LIBRARY SYSTEM
 * Features: Physical/digital books, reservations, analytics, multi-branch support
 */

// Enums for type safety and business rules
public enum BookType {
    PHYSICAL("Physical Book", 21, 3),           // 3 weeks loan, max 3 renewals
    EBOOK("Digital Book", 14, 2),              // 2 weeks loan, max 2 renewals
    AUDIOBOOK("Audio Book", 21, 2),            // 3 weeks loan, max 2 renewals
    REFERENCE("Reference Book", 7, 0),         // 1 week loan, no renewals
    RARE("Rare Book", 14, 1);                 // 2 weeks loan, max 1 renewal
    
    private final String displayName;
    private final int defaultLoanDays;
    private final int maxRenewals;
    
    BookType(String displayName, int defaultLoanDays, int maxRenewals) {
        this.displayName = displayName;
        this.defaultLoanDays = defaultLoanDays;
        this.maxRenewals = maxRenewals;
    }
    
    public String getDisplayName() { return displayName; }
    public int getDefaultLoanDays() { return defaultLoanDays; }
    public int getMaxRenewals() { return maxRenewals; }
}

public enum BookStatus {
    AVAILABLE, BORROWED, RESERVED, MAINTENANCE, LOST, DAMAGED
}

public enum MembershipType {
    STUDENT("Student", 5, new BigDecimal("0.25"), 30),
    FACULTY("Faculty", 10, new BigDecimal("0.50"), 60),
    STAFF("Staff", 7, new BigDecimal("0.50"), 45),
    PUBLIC("Public", 3, new BigDecimal("1.00"), 21),
    PREMIUM("Premium", 15, new BigDecimal("0.10"), 90);
    
    private final String displayName;
    private final int maxBooks;
    private final BigDecimal dailyLateFee;
    private final int maxLoanDays;
    
    MembershipType(String displayName, int maxBooks, BigDecimal dailyLateFee, int maxLoanDays) {
        this.displayName = displayName;
        this.maxBooks = maxBooks;
        this.dailyLateFee = dailyLateFee;
        this.maxLoanDays = maxLoanDays;
    }
    
    public String getDisplayName() { return displayName; }
    public int getMaxBooks() { return maxBooks; }
    public BigDecimal getDailyLateFee() { return dailyLateFee; }
    public int getMaxLoanDays() { return maxLoanDays; }
}

/**
 * IMMUTABLE BOOK CLASS: Comprehensive book representation
 */
public class Book {
    private final String bookId;
    private final String isbn;
    private final String title;
    private final String author;
    private final String publisher;
    private final LocalDate publicationDate;
    private final BookType type;
    private final String genre;
    private final String description;
    private final int totalCopies;
    private final String branchId;
    private final Map<String, String> metadata; // Additional properties
    
    // Mutable state
    private volatile BookStatus status;
    private volatile int availableCopies;
    private final Set<String> reservedBy; // Member IDs who reserved this book
    
    public Book(String bookId, String isbn, String title, String author, 
               String publisher, LocalDate publicationDate, BookType type, 
               String genre, String description, int totalCopies, String branchId) {
        
        // Validation
        if (bookId == null || bookId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Book ID cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (title == null || title.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Title cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (author == null || author.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Author cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (totalCopies < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Total copies cannot be negative");
        }
        
        this.bookId = bookId.trim();
        this.isbn = isbn != null ? isbn.trim() : null;
        this.title = title.trim();
        this.author = author.trim();
        this.publisher = publisher != null ? publisher.trim() : "Unknown";
        this.publicationDate = publicationDate;
        this.type = type != null ? type : BookType.PHYSICAL;
        this.genre = genre != null ? genre.trim() : "General";
        this.description = description != null ? description.trim() : "";
        this.totalCopies = totalCopies;
        this.branchId = branchId != null ? branchId.trim() : "MAIN";
        this.metadata = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        
        // Initialize mutable state
        this.status = totalCopies > 0 ? BookStatus.AVAILABLE : BookStatus.MAINTENANCE;
        this.availableCopies = totalCopies;
        this.reservedBy = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
    }
    
    /**
     * THREAD-SAFE BORROWING: Atomic operation with validation
     */
    public synchronized boolean borrowCopy(String memberId) {
        if (availableCopies <= 0) {
            return false; // No copies available
        }
        
        // Remove member from reservation list if they reserved this book
        reservedBy.remove(memberId);
        
        availableCopies--;
        if (availableCopies == 0) {
            status = BookStatus.BORROWED;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * THREAD-SAFE RETURN: Atomic operation with status update
     */
    public synchronized boolean returnCopy() {
        if (availableCopies >= totalCopies) {
            return false; // All copies already returned
        }
        
        availableCopies++;
        if (availableCopies > 0 && status == BookStatus.BORROWED) {
            status = BookStatus.AVAILABLE;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * RESERVATION SYSTEM: Queue management for popular books
     */
    public boolean reserveBook(String memberId) {
        if (availableCopies > 0) {
            return false; // Book is available, no need to reserve
        }
        
        if (reservedBy.size() >= 10) { // Max 10 reservations
            return false;
        }
        
        return reservedBy.add(memberId);
    }
    
    public boolean cancelReservation(String memberId) {
        return reservedBy.remove(memberId);
    }
    
    public List<String> getReservationQueue() {
        return new ArrayList<>(reservedBy);
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getBookId() { return bookId; }
    public String getIsbn() { return isbn; }
    public String getTitle() { return title; }
    public String getAuthor() { return author; }
    public String getPublisher() { return publisher; }
    public LocalDate getPublicationDate() { return publicationDate; }
    public BookType getType() { return type; }
    public String getGenre() { return genre; }
    public String getDescription() { return description; }
    public int getTotalCopies() { return totalCopies; }
    public int getAvailableCopies() { return availableCopies; }
    public BookStatus getStatus() { return status; }
    public String getBranchId() { return branchId; }
    public Map<String, String> getMetadata() { return new HashMap<>(metadata); }
    
    public void addMetadata(String key, String value) {
        metadata.put(key, value);
    }
    
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
        if (this == obj) return true;
        if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
        Book book = (Book) obj;
        return bookId.equals(book.bookId);
    }
    
    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return bookId.hashCode();
    }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("Book{id='%s', title='%s', author='%s', available=%d/%d, status=%s}",
                           bookId, title, author, availableCopies, totalCopies, status);
    }
}

/**
 * COMPREHENSIVE MEMBER CLASS: Full member management
 */
public class LibraryMember {
    private final String memberId;
    private final String firstName;
    private final String lastName;
    private final String email;
    private final String phoneNumber;
    private final LocalDate dateOfBirth;
    private final LocalDate membershipDate;
    private final String branchId;
    
    // Mutable state
    private MembershipType membershipType;
    private boolean isActive;
    private BigDecimal outstandingFees;
    private final Map<String, BorrowingRecord> currentBorrowings; // bookId -> BorrowingRecord
    private final List<BorrowingRecord> borrowingHistory;
    private final Set<String> reservations; // Book IDs
    
    public LibraryMember(String memberId, String firstName, String lastName, 
                        String email, String phoneNumber, LocalDate dateOfBirth,
                        MembershipType membershipType, String branchId) {
        
        // Validation
        if (memberId == null || memberId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Member ID cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (firstName == null || firstName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("First name cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (lastName == null || lastName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Last name cannot be null or empty");
        }
        if (email == null || !email.contains("@")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Valid email is required");
        }
        
        this.memberId = memberId.trim();
        this.firstName = firstName.trim();
        this.lastName = lastName.trim();
        this.email = email.trim().toLowerCase();
        this.phoneNumber = phoneNumber != null ? phoneNumber.trim() : null;
        this.dateOfBirth = dateOfBirth;
        this.membershipDate = LocalDate.now();
        this.membershipType = membershipType != null ? membershipType : MembershipType.PUBLIC;
        this.branchId = branchId != null ? branchId.trim() : "MAIN";
        
        // Initialize mutable state
        this.isActive = true;
        this.outstandingFees = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        this.currentBorrowings = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.borrowingHistory = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
        this.reservations = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
    }
    
    /**
     * BORROWING VALIDATION: Business rules enforcement
     */
    public boolean canBorrowBook(Book book) {
        // Check if member is active
        if (!isActive) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check outstanding fees
        if (outstandingFees.compareTo(new BigDecimal("10.00")) > 0) {
            return false; // Too many outstanding fees
        }
        
        // Check borrowing limit
        if (currentBorrowings.size() >= membershipType.getMaxBooks()) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check if already borrowed this book
        if (currentBorrowings.containsKey(book.getBookId())) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check if book is available
        return book.getAvailableCopies() > 0;
    }
    
    /**
     * BORROW BOOK: Complete borrowing process with record keeping
     */
    public BorrowingRecord borrowBook(Book book) {
        if (!canBorrowBook(book)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        if (!book.borrowCopy(memberId)) {
            return null; // Failed to borrow from book
        }
        
        // Calculate due date based on book type and membership
        int loanDays = Math.min(book.getType().getDefaultLoanDays(), 
                               membershipType.getMaxLoanDays());
        LocalDate dueDate = LocalDate.now().plusDays(loanDays);
        
        // Create borrowing record
        BorrowingRecord record = new BorrowingRecord(
            generateTransactionId(),
            memberId,
            book.getBookId(),
            LocalDate.now(),
            dueDate,
            book.getType()
        );
        
        // Update member state
        currentBorrowings.put(book.getBookId(), record);
        borrowingHistory.add(record);
        
        return record;
    }
    
    /**
     * RETURN BOOK: Complete return process with fee calculation
     */
    public ReturnResult returnBook(String bookId, Book book) {
        BorrowingRecord record = currentBorrowings.get(bookId);
        if (record == null) {
            return ReturnResult.failure("Book not borrowed by this member");
        }
        
        if (!book.returnCopy()) {
            return ReturnResult.failure("Failed to return book copy");
        }
        
        // Calculate late fees
        LocalDate today = LocalDate.now();
        BigDecimal lateFee = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        
        if (today.isAfter(record.getDueDate())) {
            long daysLate = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(record.getDueDate(), today);
            lateFee = membershipType.getDailyLateFee()
                     .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(daysLate));
            outstandingFees = outstandingFees.add(lateFee);
        }
        
        // Update record
        record.markReturned(today, lateFee);
        currentBorrowings.remove(bookId);
        
        return ReturnResult.success("Book returned successfully", lateFee);
    }
    
    /**
     * RESERVATION MANAGEMENT
     */
    public boolean reserveBook(String bookId) {
        if (reservations.size() >= 5) { // Max 5 reservations per member
            return false;
        }
        return reservations.add(bookId);
    }
    
    public boolean cancelReservation(String bookId) {
        return reservations.remove(bookId);
    }
    
    /**
     * FEE MANAGEMENT
     */
    public boolean payFees(BigDecimal amount) {
        if (amount.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) <= 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        outstandingFees = outstandingFees.subtract(amount);
        if (outstandingFees.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0) {
            outstandingFees = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getMemberId() { return memberId; }
    public String getFirstName() { return firstName; }
    public String getLastName() { return lastName; }
    public String getFullName() { return firstName + " " + lastName; }
    public String getEmail() { return email; }
    public String getPhoneNumber() { return phoneNumber; }
    public LocalDate getDateOfBirth() { return dateOfBirth; }
    public LocalDate getMembershipDate() { return membershipDate; }
    public MembershipType getMembershipType() { return membershipType; }
    public boolean isActive() { return isActive; }
    public BigDecimal getOutstandingFees() { return outstandingFees; }
    public String getBranchId() { return branchId; }
    
    public Map<String, BorrowingRecord> getCurrentBorrowings() {
        return new HashMap<>(currentBorrowings);
    }
    
    public List<BorrowingRecord> getBorrowingHistory() {
        return new ArrayList<>(borrowingHistory);
    }
    
    public Set<String> getReservations() {
        return new HashSet<>(reservations);
    }
    
    public void setMembershipType(MembershipType membershipType) {
        this.membershipType = membershipType;
    }
    
    public void setActive(boolean active) {
        this.isActive = active;
    }
    
    private String generateTransactionId() {
        return "TXN_" + System.currentTimeMillis() + "_" + 
               (int)(Math.random() * 10000);
    }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("LibraryMember{id='%s', name='%s', type=%s, books=%d, fees=$%.2f}",
                           memberId, getFullName(), membershipType, 
                           currentBorrowings.size(), outstandingFees);
    }
}

/**
 * BORROWING RECORD: Immutable transaction record
 */
public class BorrowingRecord {
    private final String transactionId;
    private final String memberId;
    private final String bookId;
    private final LocalDate borrowDate;
    private final LocalDate dueDate;
    private final BookType bookType;
    
    // Mutable return information
    private LocalDate returnDate;
    private BigDecimal lateFee;
    private int renewalCount;
    
    public BorrowingRecord(String transactionId, String memberId, String bookId,
                          LocalDate borrowDate, LocalDate dueDate, BookType bookType) {
        this.transactionId = transactionId;
        this.memberId = memberId;
        this.bookId = bookId;
        this.borrowDate = borrowDate;
        this.dueDate = dueDate;
        this.bookType = bookType;
        this.lateFee = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        this.renewalCount = 0;
    }
    
    public void markReturned(LocalDate returnDate, BigDecimal lateFee) {
        this.returnDate = returnDate;
        this.lateFee = lateFee;
    }
    
    public boolean renew() {
        if (renewalCount >= bookType.getMaxRenewals()) {
            return false;
        }
        
        renewalCount++;
        // Extend due date by the default loan period
        LocalDate newDueDate = dueDate.plusDays(bookType.getDefaultLoanDays());
        return true;
    }
    
    public boolean isOverdue() {
        return returnDate == null && LocalDate.now().isAfter(dueDate);
    }
    
    public boolean isReturned() {
        return returnDate != null;
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getTransactionId() { return transactionId; }
    public String getMemberId() { return memberId; }
    public String getBookId() { return bookId; }
    public LocalDate getBorrowDate() { return borrowDate; }
    public LocalDate getDueDate() { return dueDate; }
    public LocalDate getReturnDate() { return returnDate; }
    public BigDecimal getLateFee() { return lateFee; }
    public int getRenewalCount() { return renewalCount; }
    public BookType getBookType() { return bookType; }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("BorrowingRecord{txn='%s', member='%s', book='%s', due=%s, returned=%s, fee=$%.2f}",
                           transactionId, memberId, bookId, dueDate, 
                           returnDate != null ? returnDate : "Not returned", lateFee);
    }
}

/**
 * RETURN RESULT: Type-safe return operation results
 */
public class ReturnResult {
    private final boolean success;
    private final String message;
    private final BigDecimal lateFee;
    private final LocalDateTime timestamp;
    
    private ReturnResult(boolean success, String message, BigDecimal lateFee) {
        this.success = success;
        this.message = message;
        this.lateFee = lateFee != null ? lateFee : BigDecimal.ZERO;
        this.timestamp = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
    
    public static ReturnResult success(String message, BigDecimal lateFee) {
        return new ReturnResult(true, message, lateFee);
    }
    
    public static ReturnResult failure(String message) {
        return new ReturnResult(false, message, BigDecimal.ZERO);
    }
    
    public boolean isSuccess() { return success; }
    public String getMessage() { return message; }
    public BigDecimal getLateFee() { return lateFee; }
    public LocalDateTime getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("ReturnResult{success=%s, message='%s', lateFee=$%.2f}",
                           success, message, lateFee);
    }
}
/**
 * DIGITAL LIBRARY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM: Enterprise-grade library management
 * Features: Multi-branch, analytics, recommendations, external integrations
 */
public class DigitalLibrarySystem {
    private final String systemId;
    private final String systemName;
    
    // Core collections (thread-safe)
    private final Map<String, Book> books;                    // bookId -> Book
    private final Map<String, LibraryMember> members;         // memberId -> Member
    private final Map<String, BorrowingRecord> transactions;  // transactionId -> Record
    private final Map<String, String> branches;              // branchId -> branchName
    
    // Search indexes for performance
    private final Map<String, Set<String>> booksByAuthor;     // author -> bookIds
    private final Map<String, Set<String>> booksByGenre;      // genre -> bookIds
    private final Map<String, Set<String>> booksByBranch;     // branchId -> bookIds
    private final Map<String, Set<String>> membersByBranch;   // branchId -> memberIds
    
    // Analytics and caching
    private final Map<String, Integer> popularBooks;          // bookId -> borrowCount
    private final Map<String, LocalDateTime> lastActivity;    // memberId -> lastActivity
    
    public DigitalLibrarySystem(String systemId, String systemName) {
        if (systemId == null || systemId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("System ID cannot be null or empty");
        }
        
        this.systemId = systemId.trim();
        this.systemName = systemName != null ? systemName.trim() : "Digital Library";
        
        // Initialize thread-safe collections
        this.books = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.members = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.transactions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.branches = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        
        // Initialize search indexes
        this.booksByAuthor = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.booksByGenre = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.booksByBranch = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.membersByBranch = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        
        // Initialize analytics
        this.popularBooks = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        this.lastActivity = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        
        // Add default main branch
        addBranch("MAIN", "Main Library Branch");
    }
    
    /**
     * BRANCH MANAGEMENT
     */
    public boolean addBranch(String branchId, String branchName) {
        if (branchId == null || branchId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        
        branches.put(branchId.trim(), branchName != null ? branchName.trim() : branchId);
        booksByBranch.putIfAbsent(branchId, ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet());
        membersByBranch.putIfAbsent(branchId, ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet());
        
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * BOOK MANAGEMENT: Add books with automatic indexing
     */
    public boolean addBook(Book book) {
        if (book == null || books.containsKey(book.getBookId())) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Add to main collection
        books.put(book.getBookId(), book);
        
        // Update search indexes
        booksByAuthor.computeIfAbsent(book.getAuthor().toLowerCase(), 
                                    k -> ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet())
                    .add(book.getBookId());
        
        booksByGenre.computeIfAbsent(book.getGenre().toLowerCase(), 
                                   k -> ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet())
                   .add(book.getBookId());
        
        booksByBranch.computeIfAbsent(book.getBranchId(), 
                                    k -> ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet())
                    .add(book.getBookId());
        
        // Initialize popularity tracking
        popularBooks.put(book.getBookId(), 0);
        
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * MEMBER MANAGEMENT: Add members with validation
     */
    public boolean addMember(LibraryMember member) {
        if (member == null || members.containsKey(member.getMemberId())) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Validate branch exists
        if (!branches.containsKey(member.getBranchId())) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Add to main collection
        members.put(member.getMemberId(), member);
        
        // Update branch index
        membersByBranch.computeIfAbsent(member.getBranchId(), 
                                      k -> ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet())
                      .add(member.getMemberId());
        
        // Initialize activity tracking
        lastActivity.put(member.getMemberId(), LocalDateTime.now());
        
        return true;
    }
    
    /**
     * BORROWING SYSTEM: Complete borrowing workflow
     */
    public BorrowingRecord borrowBook(String memberId, String bookId) {
        LibraryMember member = members.get(memberId);
        Book book = books.get(bookId);
        
        if (member == null || book == null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Attempt to borrow
        BorrowingRecord record = member.borrowBook(book);
        if (record != null) {
            // Update system records
            transactions.put(record.getTransactionId(), record);
            
            // Update analytics
            popularBooks.merge(bookId, 1, Integer::sum);
            lastActivity.put(memberId, LocalDateTime.now());
        }
        
        return record;
    }
    
    /**
     * RETURN SYSTEM: Complete return workflow
     */
    public ReturnResult returnBook(String memberId, String bookId) {
        LibraryMember member = members.get(memberId);
        Book book = books.get(bookId);
        
        if (member == null || book == null) {
            return ReturnResult.failure("Member or book not found");
        }
        
        ReturnResult result = member.returnBook(bookId, book);
        if (result.isSuccess()) {
            lastActivity.put(memberId, LocalDateTime.now());
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    /**
     * ADVANCED SEARCH: Multi-criteria book search
     */
    public List<Book> searchBooks(String query, String author, String genre, 
                                 BookType type, String branchId) {
        Set<String> candidateIds = new HashSet<>(books.keySet());
        
        // Filter by author
        if (author != null && !author.trim().isEmpty()) {
            Set<String> authorBooks = booksByAuthor.get(author.toLowerCase());
            if (authorBooks != null) {
                candidateIds.retainAll(authorBooks);
            } else {
                return new ArrayList<>(); // No books by this author
            }
        }
        
        // Filter by genre
        if (genre != null && !genre.trim().isEmpty()) {
            Set<String> genreBooks = booksByGenre.get(genre.toLowerCase());
            if (genreBooks != null) {
                candidateIds.retainAll(genreBooks);
            } else {
                return new ArrayList<>(); // No books in this genre
            }
        }
        
        // Filter by branch
        if (branchId != null && !branchId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            Set<String> branchBooks = booksByBranch.get(branchId);
            if (branchBooks != null) {
                candidateIds.retainAll(branchBooks);
            } else {
                return new ArrayList<>(); // No books in this branch
            }
        }
        
        // Apply remaining filters and text search
        return candidateIds.stream()
            .map(books::get)
            .filter(Objects::nonNull)
            .filter(book -> type == null || book.getType() == type)
            .filter(book -> query == null || query.trim().isEmpty() || 
                           book.getTitle().toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase()) ||
                           book.getAuthor().toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase()) ||
                           book.getDescription().toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase()))
            .sorted((a, b) -> {
                // Sort by availability first, then by popularity
                if (a.getAvailableCopies() != b.getAvailableCopies()) {
                    return Integer.compare(b.getAvailableCopies(), a.getAvailableCopies());
                }
                return Integer.compare(popularBooks.getOrDefault(b.getBookId(), 0),
                                     popularBooks.getOrDefault(a.getBookId(), 0));
            })
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
    
    /**
     * RECOMMENDATION ENGINE: Personalized book recommendations
     */
    public List<Book> getRecommendations(String memberId, int limit) {
        LibraryMember member = members.get(memberId);
        if (member == null) {
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        // Analyze member's borrowing history
        Map<String, Integer> genrePreferences = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String, Integer> authorPreferences = new HashMap<>();
        
        for (BorrowingRecord record : member.getBorrowingHistory()) {
            Book book = books.get(record.getBookId());
            if (book != null) {
                genrePreferences.merge(book.getGenre().toLowerCase(), 1, Integer::sum);
                authorPreferences.merge(book.getAuthor().toLowerCase(), 1, Integer::sum);
            }
        }
        
        // Find books in preferred genres/authors that member hasn't borrowed
        Set<String> borrowedBooks = member.getBorrowingHistory().stream()
            .map(BorrowingRecord::getBookId)
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());
        
        return books.values().stream()
            .filter(book -> !borrowedBooks.contains(book.getBookId()))
            .filter(book -> book.getAvailableCopies() > 0)
            .filter(book -> genrePreferences.containsKey(book.getGenre().toLowerCase()) ||
                           authorPreferences.containsKey(book.getAuthor().toLowerCase()))
            .sorted((a, b) -> {
                // Score based on genre and author preferences
                int scoreA = genrePreferences.getOrDefault(a.getGenre().toLowerCase(), 0) +
                           authorPreferences.getOrDefault(a.getAuthor().toLowerCase(), 0);
                int scoreB = genrePreferences.getOrDefault(b.getGenre().toLowerCase(), 0) +
                           authorPreferences.getOrDefault(b.getAuthor().toLowerCase(), 0);
                
                if (scoreA != scoreB) {
                    return Integer.compare(scoreB, scoreA);
                }
                
                // Secondary sort by popularity
                return Integer.compare(popularBooks.getOrDefault(b.getBookId(), 0),
                                     popularBooks.getOrDefault(a.getBookId(), 0));
            })
            .limit(limit)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
    
    /**
     * ANALYTICS: System-wide statistics
     */
    public LibraryAnalytics getAnalytics() {
        int totalBooks = books.size();
        int totalMembers = members.size();
        int totalBorrowings = transactions.size();
        
        // Calculate availability rate
        long availableBooks = books.values().stream()
            .mapToLong(Book::getAvailableCopies)
            .sum();
        long totalCopies = books.values().stream()
            .mapToLong(Book::getTotalCopies)
            .sum();
        double availabilityRate = totalCopies > 0 ? (double) availableBooks / totalCopies * 100.0 : 0.0;
        
        // Find most popular books
        List<String> mostPopularBooks = popularBooks.entrySet().stream()
            .sorted(Map.Entry.<String, Integer>comparingByValue().reversed())
            .limit(10)
            .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
        
        // Calculate overdue books
        long overdueCount = members.values().stream()
            .flatMap(member -> member.getCurrentBorrowings().values().stream())
            .mapToLong(record -> record.isOverdue() ? 1 : 0)
            .sum();
        
        // Calculate total outstanding fees
        BigDecimal totalFees = members.values().stream()
            .map(LibraryMember::getOutstandingFees)
            .reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add);
        
        return new LibraryAnalytics(
            totalBooks, totalMembers, totalBorrowings,
            availabilityRate, mostPopularBooks, overdueCount, totalFees
        );
    }
    
    // Getters
    public String getSystemId() { return systemId; }
    public String getSystemName() { return systemName; }
    public Map<String, String> getBranches() { return new HashMap<>(branches); }
    
    public Book getBook(String bookId) { return books.get(bookId); }
    public LibraryMember getMember(String memberId) { return members.get(memberId); }
    public BorrowingRecord getTransaction(String transactionId) { return transactions.get(transactionId); }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("DigitalLibrarySystem{id='%s', name='%s', books=%d, members=%d, branches=%d}",
                           systemId, systemName, books.size(), members.size(), branches.size());
    }
}

/**
 * LIBRARY ANALYTICS: Comprehensive system statistics
 */
public class LibraryAnalytics {
    private final int totalBooks;
    private final int totalMembers;
    private final int totalBorrowings;
    private final double availabilityRate;
    private final List<String> mostPopularBooks;
    private final long overdueCount;
    private final BigDecimal totalOutstandingFees;
    private final LocalDateTime generatedAt;
    
    public LibraryAnalytics(int totalBooks, int totalMembers, int totalBorrowings,
                           double availabilityRate, List<String> mostPopularBooks,
                           long overdueCount, BigDecimal totalOutstandingFees) {
        this.totalBooks = totalBooks;
        this.totalMembers = totalMembers;
        this.totalBorrowings = totalBorrowings;
        this.availabilityRate = availabilityRate;
        this.mostPopularBooks = new ArrayList<>(mostPopularBooks);
        this.overdueCount = overdueCount;
        this.totalOutstandingFees = totalOutstandingFees;
        this.generatedAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }
    
    // Getters
    public int getTotalBooks() { return totalBooks; }
    public int getTotalMembers() { return totalMembers; }
    public int getTotalBorrowings() { return totalBorrowings; }
    public double getAvailabilityRate() { return availabilityRate; }
    public List<String> getMostPopularBooks() { return new ArrayList<>(mostPopularBooks); }
    public long getOverdueCount() { return overdueCount; }
    public BigDecimal getTotalOutstandingFees() { return totalOutstandingFees; }
    public LocalDateTime getGeneratedAt() { return generatedAt; }
    
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.format("LibraryAnalytics{books=%d, members=%d, borrowings=%d, availability=%.1f%%, overdue=%d, fees=$%.2f}",
                           totalBooks, totalMembers, totalBorrowings, availabilityRate, overdueCount, totalOutstandingFees);
    }
}

### Complexity Analysis

**Time Complexity**:
- **Book/Member Addition**: O(1) - hash map insertion with indexing
- **Book Search**: O(n) - where n is number of matching books (optimized with indexes)
- **Borrowing/Returning**: O(1) - direct hash map access
- **Recommendations**: O(n log n) - sorting books by preference score
- **Analytics Generation**: O(n) - single pass through collections

**Space Complexity**:
- **Core Storage**: O(b + m + t) - where b=books, m=members, t=transactions
- **Search Indexes**: O(b) - additional indexes for fast lookups
- **Analytics Cache**: O(1) - fixed size analytics data

### Performance Optimizations

| Feature | Optimization | Benefit |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| Book Search | Multi-level indexing | O(1) author/genre filtering |
| Member Lookup | Hash map storage | O(1) member access |
| Popular Books | Cached counters | Real-time popularity tracking |
| Branch Filtering | Pre-computed indexes | Fast multi-branch queries |
| Recommendations | Preference scoring | Personalized suggestions |

### Real-World Applications

**Amazon Kindle Library System**:
- Similar digital book management with lending periods
- Recommendation engine based on reading history
- Multi-device synchronization and access control
- Integration with purchase and subscription systems

**University Library Systems (Ex Libris Alma)**:
- Multi-branch management across campus locations
- Integration with academic databases and journals
- Student/faculty different borrowing privileges
- Course reserve and reading list management

**Public Library Networks (Koha, Evergreen)**:
- Inter-library loan systems for resource sharing
- Community event and program management
- Digital resource access and authentication
- Mobile app integration for catalog browsing

### Follow-up Questions

1. **"How would you implement inter-library loan functionality?"** (Distributed systems, API integration)
2. **"How would you handle digital rights management for ebooks?"** (DRM, licensing, access control)
3. **"How would you implement a mobile app API?"** (REST API design, authentication, offline sync)
4. **"How would you scale this for a city-wide library network?"** (Microservices, database sharding)
5. **"How would you implement automated book recommendations using machine learning?"** (Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering)
6. **"How would you handle book damage reporting and replacement workflows?"** (State management, workflow automation)

### Key Learning Points

- **Domain Modeling**: Rich object model representing real-world library concepts
- **Business Rules**: Complex validation and fee calculation logic
- **Data Relationships**: Proper modeling of many-to-many relationships
- **Search Optimization**: Multi-level indexing for fast query performance
- **Analytics**: Real-time statistics and reporting capabilities
- **Extensibility**: Design supports digital books, multiple branches, and future features
